import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:N+1]]
    
    # Precompute subset sums
    size = 1 << N
    sums = [0] * size
    for S in range(1, size):
        low_bit_pos = (S & -S).bit_length() - 1

            T = sub | low
            stack.append((S ^ T, x ^ sums[T]))
